objective: Prepare Google Colab as a bounded ShortForge rendering backend using the allowlisted Colab Runtime API and standard Jupyter interface, ending in physical MP4 verification while preserving F06 worker and F07 authority boundaries.

rulesConsidered: Notebook providers are rendering backends in this workstream.
F06 worker admission remains separate from provider execution.
F07 remains the independent physical-artifact evidence boundary.
Provider credentials and short-lived runtime proxy tokens must not be exposed through MCP arguments or persisted in runtime records.
No synthetic success is permitted when remote execution or artifact retrieval fails.

notes: No provider secret values are committed.
Colab runtime proxy tokens are retained only in process memory.
The Jupyter bridge is bounded to one kernel execution and runtime-owned artifact retrieval.

conflicts.originalConflict: The existing Colab adapter was control-plane-only, while ShortForge's notebook providers are required to serve the rendering path.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Implement a bounded Jupyter execution and artifact-retrieval bridge behind ColabNotebookAdapter rather than using browser MCP as the production render path.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Colab uses the allowlisted Runtime API for runtime lifecycle and the runtime's Jupyter interface for rendering; F06 admission and F07 artifact truth remain outside the adapter.

changes: Upgraded ColabNotebookAdapter from control-only to bounded Jupyter-backed rendering execution.
Added Google ADC support alongside explicit ephemeral Colab access tokens.
Added eligible runtime-spec selection and managed runtime lifecycle.
Added Jupyter kernel WebSocket execution bridge with stdout/stderr and exit-code capture.
Added physical artifact retrieval, SHA-256, byte-length, and MP4 ftyp verification.
Added deterministic Colab physical-render workflow switch and bridge dependency checks.
Updated notebook render-fabric and MCP governance documentation.
verificationPlan: Run repository CI, notebook-fabric contract tests, MCP contract tests, and Python bridge syntax validation.
After Colab API allowlist approval, enable colaboratory.googleapis.com on the submitted GCP project.
Run COLAB_LIVE_RENDER=1 against an eligible T4 runtime.
Require PHYSICAL_ARTIFACT_VERIFIED, non-empty artifact, SHA-256, byte length, and MP4 ftyp proof.
Retain Colab productionWorkerEligible=false until the independent F06 worker admission contract is satisfied.
notes: Implementation is prepared but external Colab provider evidence remains pending because the submitted project is not yet permitted to enable the Colab API.
No Colab live render is claimed by this PR.
Kaggle and Lightning are tracked separately: Kaggle physical-artifact proof is already complete; Lightning latest live proof is code-execution verified and still needs physical MP4 transfer proof.
